Editing this file runs the SMTP boundary. It deploys nothing, builds nothing,
and touches no identity, migration, RLS or Vercel setting. It does not
bootstrap.

sequence: credential and TLS verification -> configure Supabase SMTP ->
          independent read-back and assertion -> controlled delivery test ->
          STOP.

delivery test: exactly one message, from noreply@pintarselalu.com to
          noreply@pintarselalu.com. Our own mailbox, no third party, nothing
          addressed to Gladys or any PINTAR identity. It carries the run id so
          the message can be matched to the run.

dns:      SPF, DKIM (default selector) and DMARC all resolve on
          pintarselalu.com. DMARC is p=none, which is reported as a warning
          and does not affect delivery.

not in scope: SYSTEM_ADMIN bootstrap, the 3c platform_environment
          transition, the Vercel redeploy for the service-role key, school
          onboarding, and instructing Gladys to sign in.
